Maju Forest
properties.name: Maju Forest
properties.context: Secondary forest near the former Maju Camp (Clementi / Ulu Pandan area). Named by MND alongside Gillman Barracks (Aug 2026) as a site that will need to be developed to meet housing needs over the next decade.
properties.wildlife: Secondary-forest fauna; part of a green corridor linking Clementi/Ulu Pandan patches.
properties.status: Flagged for development within the next decade (MND, 2026).

properties.label: Dover Forest West
properties.name: Dover Forest West
properties.context: Western half of Dover Forest at Ulu Pandan. After a 2021 review, Dover Forest East was released for HDB flats while the West was deferred for further study and phased development.
properties.wildlife: Sunda pangolin, grey-headed fish eagle and straw-headed bulbul have been recorded in the wider Dover/Ulu Pandan area.
properties.status: Deferred/phased after 2021 review; remains zoned for eventual development.
